verdict.rationale: Appwrite's CLI explicitly supports non-interactive/headless scripted usage (appwrite-docs-42), can create/manage projects, resources, users, functions, deployments (appwrite-docs-12/18/32), and databases/auth/policies are all provisionable via the CLI/API per the docs; this is exactly the kind of scriptable backend-standup an agent could drive headlessly. missing for 10: no end-to-end hands-on example/transcript of an agent actually scripting full schema+auth+policy setup in one script, and no independent/community verification of headless CLI workflows.
